proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report analyzing congruency of political and electioneering expenditures with publicly stated company values and policies, including reputational risk.

proposals.title: Item 6 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Access to COVID-19 Products
proposals.topic_summary: Requests report on whether public financial support for COVID-19 vaccine or therapeutics is considered in decisions affecting access to such products, such as pricing.
